title: Protective helmets for two wheeler riders - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope_description: Safety specification and testing methods for protective helmets for drivers and passengers of motorcycles and two-wheelers. Specifies laboratory testing for impact absorption test, retention system test, chin strap strength test, and peripheral vision. Mandatory under Motor Vehicles Act and BIS QCO.
notes: Mandatory ISI marking required for all two-wheeler helmets sold in India.

title: Safety of toys - Part 1: Safety aspects related to mechanical and physical properties
scope_description: Safety requirements and laboratory test methods for toys intended for children under 14 years. Covers mechanical testing, sharp edges test, sharp points test, small parts test, choking hazards test, impact and drop tests. Mandatory under Toys (Quality Control) Order.
notes: Mandatory ISI certification for domestic toy manufacturers and foreign importers.

title: Domestic pressure cookers - Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope_description: Safety and performance requirements and test methods for domestic pressure cookers made from aluminium alloys or stainless steel. Specifies operating pressure test, proof pressure test, burst pressure test, safety valve release test, and gasket durability testing. Mandatory under DPIIT QCO.
notes: Mandatory ISI certification under Domestic Pressure Cooker (Quality Control) Order.

title: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V
scope_description: Requirements and electrical testing methods for single-core and multi-core PVC insulated electrical cables and wires for household and industrial wiring. Spark test, insulation resistance test, and conductor resistance test. Mandatory safety standard.
notes: Mandatory ISI mark for electrical cables and wires.

title: Domestic gas stoves for use with liquefied petroleum gases - Specification
scope_description: Safety and performance requirements and laboratory test methods for domestic LPG gas stoves/cooktops. Specifies thermal efficiency test (minimum 68%), gas leakage resistance test, burner performance test, and flame stability test.
notes: Mandatory ISI mark under Gas Stoves Quality Control Order.
